=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1039-11452 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `post_state_comment` failures are still swallowed by `|| true`, so V2 persistence errors do not stop the poller.
  WHY: Reviewers verified that the new V2 writer returns non-zero on pack/post failures, but the callers discard that return code and later poll cycles can re-read stale persisted state and repeat work.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:660-695 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The inline guidance says operators can raise `CONFLICT_RESOLVER_PER_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_SECS` for a PR, but the code clamps anything above 3000 back to 3000.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed the documented tuning path does not actually let operators exceed the hard cap; some noted the mismatch is pre-existing, but the behavior/documentation conflict remains.
- tests/test_detect_editor_changes_lost.py:320-364 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The test asserts exact workflow prose instead of structural behavior, so non-functional wording edits can fail CI.
  WHY: Several reviewers noted the string match on the workflow text is brittle even though the shim invocation itself is unchanged.
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:139-200 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `_try_parse_v2_chunk` locates the V2 closer with an unanchored `rfind`, so prose containing `ORCHESTRATOR_STATE_V2 -->` can terminate extraction at the wrong place.
  WHY: The opener is line-anchored but the closer is not, which can corrupt the payload and force fallback to stale state.
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:86-185 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `cmd_pack` has no write-time upper bound on chunk count, so a tiny `--chunk-size` can create excessive chunk files.
  WHY: The extractor enforces `MAX_CHUNKS_PER_MANIFEST` at read time, but the pack path can still exhaust disk/inodes before that guard applies.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3726-3866 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The resolver bootstrap only warns on some fallback paths, so parse errors in the primary resolver can be obscured when a fallback succeeds.
  WHY: The reviewer noted that unresolved conflict markers in the in-tree script may never be surfaced if the workflow silently switches to a fallback copy.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3726-3866 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The resolver bootstrap can exit 2 when the fallback copies are missing or unparseable even though a clean in-tree resolver exists.
  WHY: The reviewer reported that the probe chain treats the consumer-repo case as a hard failure and blocks conflict resolution entirely.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:135-137 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `_looks_like_re_escape_output` can accept patterns with unescaped metacharacters because the round-trip heuristic is too permissive.
  WHY: The reviewer noted that strings like `[abc]` or `|` can satisfy the round-trip check even though they are not literal `re.escape` output.
- .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml:218-222 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The mark-stable release gate omits the new `test_detect_editor_changes_lost.py` even though CI runs it.
  WHY: A regression in the editor-changes-lost logic could escape the release gate because the release workflow does not include that test in its allowlist.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
